feeds.title: Doug Newdick's Blog
feeds.description: This is Doug Newdick's blog on business and technology. I am interested in, and write about, the application of philosophical, architectural and strategic thinking to business problems and technology solutions. I currently work as an enterprise architect in the New Zealand government. I have a particular interest in the telecommunications industry and its business support systems (BSS).

feeds.title: Tom Graves Blog

Tom Graves is a seventy-year-old enterprise architect having worked in the industry for decades.
